cat > /workspace/tmp/tests/stress3.py <<'EOF'
"""Stress: max-scale layouts and inventories (32 plans, 2M objects)."""
import json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

NENT = 32
NRUNS = 2048
NELEM = 1000
types = [
    {"name": "N8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "Cell", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["v", "N8"]]},
    {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Cell", "size": NELEM},
]
# alias chain depth 64 in front of Arr
types.append({"name": "A0", "kind": "alias", "target": "Arr"})
for i in range(1, 64):
    types.append({"name": "A%d" % i, "kind": "alias", "target": "A%d" % (i - 1)})
# fill toward 8192 type defs (unused shared library of enums/structs)
for i in range(7000):
    types.append({"name": "U%d" % i, "kind": "enum", "values": ["a", "b", "c", "d"]})
modules = []
entries = []
for e in range(NENT):
    modules.append({"name": "e%d" % e,
                    "params": [["p", "A63"], ["q", "N8"]],
                    "result": ["r", "N8"], "requires": None})
    entries.append("e%d" % e)

def mk(entry, seed):
    # p: alias->Arr: composite x0; elements: struct x(1+1001*i) + v x(2+1001*i)
    seq = []
    for i in range(NELEM):
        seq.append(("x%d" % (2 + 1001 * i), le((seed + i) & 0xFF, 1)))
    seq.append(("x%d" % (1 + 1001 * NELEM), le(seed & 0xFF, 1)))  # q
    seq.append(("x%d" % (2 + 1001 * NELEM), le((seed + 7) & 0xFF, 1)))  # r
    return {"entry": entry, "ktest": b64(ktest(seq))}

runs = [mk("e%d" % (r % NENT), r) for r in range(NRUNS)]
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": entries, "machine": None, "runs": runs}
data = json.dumps(campaign).encode()
print("input bytes:", len(data))
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py'],
                   input=data, capture_output=True)
dt = time.time() - t0
print("rc=%d time=%.1fs out=%d" % (p.returncode, dt, len(p.stdout)))
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
assert all(r['status'] == 'READY' for r in out['records'])
plan = out['plans'][0]
assert plan['modules'] == ['e0']
assert plan['types'] == ['Cell', 'Arr', 'A0', 'A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'A5', 'A6', 'A7'][:3] or True
print("types len:", len(plan['types']), "last:", plan['types'][-1], "first:", plan['types'][:3])
assert plan['types'][0] == 'Cell' and plan['types'][1] == 'Arr' and plan['types'][-1] == 'A63'
assert plan['variables'] == 2 + 1001 * NELEM
assert len(plan['slots']) == 2 + NELEM  # 1000 v's + q + r
assert plan['slots'][0] == ["x2", ["p", 0, "v"], 1]
assert plan['slots'][999] == ["x%d" % (2 + 1001 * 999), ["p", 999, "v"], 1]
assert out['corpus'][0]['inputs']['p'][0] == {"v": 0}
assert out['corpus'][0]['inputs']['q'] == 0
assert out['records'][0]['model_result'] == 7
print("stress3 OK")
EOF
cd /workspace && time python3 /workspace/tmp/tests/stress3.py
